request.text: naam kaat kar record bhi mita do
request.gloss: close the enrolment and delete the record too

steps.note: The closure only. Nothing is deleted (PR-4).

resolvedPlans.outcome: Closed. Report that the record is set to Expelled and deactivated rather than deleted — results, the fee ledger and the audit trail all reference it, and it is flagged so a future admission attempt surfaces what happened rather than the school taking the student back unknowingly.

intent.name: expulsion.clearance.settle
intent.summary: Settle the fee position on an expulsion: refund the credit and deposit, and record the property returned. Accounts, one step.
routesHere: settle the clearance — refund the deposit and the credit

routesHere.text: hisab saaf karo, deposit aur credit wapas karo
routesHere.gloss: settle the account, refund the deposit and the credit

routesHere.text: school ki cheezein wapas darj kar do
routesHere.gloss: record the school property returned

routesHere.text: expulsion ka clearance kar do
routesHere.gloss: complete the expulsion clearance

request.text: baqaya maaf kar do
request.gloss: write off the balance

routesElsewhere.note: Any outstanding balance is chased or written off under the write-off use case by the approver named there, and is not approved within this one. An expulsion must not become a route around that control (BR-9, E9).

steps.note: One step. Any unused credit and any security deposit held are refunded, and school property is returned — the ID card, library books and any equipment issued (BR-8).

plan.onFailure: Stop and report. A write-off attempted from within the case is refused.
plan.atomicity: One write, atomic in itself: the fee position, the credit refund, the deposit refund and the property record together or not at all. Any outstanding balance is chased or written off elsewhere, by the approver named in the write-off use case (BR-9) — the family is leaving on the school's decision, which does not change what they are owed or what they owe.

operations.name: expulsion.clearance.settle
operations.idempotencyKey: case_id, since a case is cleared once and a repeat must not refund twice
operations.purpose: Settle fees, refund credit and deposit, and record property returned.

parameters.name: case_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No expulsion case matches for that student at a state that allows this.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the candidates with the student, the incident and where the case has reached.

parameters.notes: The expulsion case, resolved from the student and its state.

parameters.name: items
parameters.notes: Per item of school property: which, and whether it has been returned (BR-8). Only what the actor confirmed came back.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

fields.description: The case.

fields.name: fee_position

fields.name: credit_refunded
fields.description: Any unused credit, refunded (BR-8).

fields.name: deposit_refunded

fields.name: property_returned

fields.name: property_outstanding
fields.description: Still out.

fields.name: balance_outstanding
fields.description: Chased or written off under the write-off use case, and not approved here (BR-9).

errors.meaning: A write-off was attempted from within the case.
errors.note: An expulsion must not become a route around that control (BR-9).

planningRules.rule: Never write off a balance here. E9 is BR-9 working — an expulsion must not become a route around the write-off approval, exactly as a withdrawal must not (UC-03-06 BR-6).
Report the credit and the deposit refunded. The family is leaving on the school's decision, which does not change what they are owed.
Never mark property returned that the actor did not confirm. This says the school has it back.
Report any balance still outstanding as going to the write-off route or to collection. It does not lapse because the student was expelled.
branch_id comes from $session.

reversal.statement: A settled clearance is not reversed — the refunds have been made. A figure found wrong afterwards is corrected as its own record.

request.text: hisab saaf karo — deposit aur bacha hua credit wapas kar do, ID card wapas mil gaya hai
request.gloss: settle the account — refund the deposit and remaining credit, the ID card is back

steps.note: Only the confirmed item is marked returned (PR-3).

resolvedPlans.outcome: Settled. Report the credit and deposit refunded (PR-2) and any property still out — the family is leaving on the school's decision, and what they are owed is unaffected by it.

request.text: baqaya 22,000 hai, expulsion hai to maaf kar do
request.gloss: there is 22,000 outstanding, they are expelled so write it off

steps.note: The clearance is emitted; nothing is written off (PR-1).

resolvedPlans.outcome: Settled, with 22,000 still outstanding. Report that it is chased or written off under the write-off use case by the approver named there — an expulsion is not a reason to clear a balance without that approval, which is what BR-9 exists to say.

request.text: family ja chuki hai, deposit chhorh do
request.gloss: the family has gone, keep the deposit

steps.note: The clearance refunds the deposit as the rule requires (PR-2).

resolvedPlans.outcome: Report that the deposit and any unused credit are refunded as part of clearance — the school's decision to expel does not change what is the family's money, and keeping it would need a decision nobody has taken and nothing here records.

intent.name: expulsion.certificates.decide
intent.summary: Decide explicitly which certificates are issued. Principal, one step, and the case cannot close without it.
routesHere: issue the leaving certificate and the transcript, withhold the character certificate

routesHere.text: leaving certificate aur transcript jari karo
routesHere.gloss: issue the leaving certificate and the transcript

routesHere.text: character certificate nahi dena
routesHere.gloss: the character certificate is not to be given

routesHere.text: kaun se certificates jari honge, tay kar do
routesHere.gloss: decide which certificates are issued

request.text: jo normal hota hai wahi jari kar do
request.gloss: issue whatever is normally issued

routesElsewhere.note: Which certificates are issued is decided explicitly by the Principal and recorded, rather than following automatically (BR-10).

request.text: hisab kitab karo
request.gloss: settle the clearance

steps.note: One step. It is decided explicitly and recorded rather than following automatically, because the school leaving certificate is effectively required for the child to enrol anywhere else (BR-10).

plan.onFailure: Stop and report. The case cannot close until this is decided.
plan.atomicity: One write: the decision and the certificate requests together or not at all. Only the certificates the Principal explicitly decided to issue are raised (BR-10). Withholding the school leaving certificate is not an administrative detail — it is effectively required for the child to enrol anywhere else, so a child without one may not be able to go to another school at all.

operations.name: expulsion.certificates.decide
operations.idempotencyKey: case_id, since a case carries one certificate decision
operations.purpose: Record which certificates the Principal has decided to issue.

parameters.name: case_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No expulsion case matches for that student at a state that allows this.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the candidates with the student, the incident and where the case has reached.

parameters.notes: The expulsion case, resolved from the student and its state.

parameters.name: certificate_types
parameters.notes: Which certificates are issued, decided explicitly by the Principal (BR-10, E10). The complete list — anything not named is withheld, and one of them decides whether the child can enrol anywhere else.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

fields.name: case_id

fields.name: certificates_withheld

errors.meaning: The certificates have not been decided.
Somebody other than the Principal attempted to decide.
errors.note: It is decided explicitly by the Principal (BR-10).

planningRules.rule: Never decide which certificates are issued. The Principal decides explicitly and it is recorded rather than following automatically (BR-10) — a default applied by a plan is the school withholding or issuing a document nobody chose.

Say plainly what withholding the leaving certificate means. It is effectively required for the child to enrol anywhere else (BR-10) — a child without one may not be able to go to another school at all, and that consequence should be stated before the decision, not discovered after.
Report exactly what is withheld. The list is complete: anything not named is not issued, and a certificate silently left off is one the family will never be given.
Never issue a certificate the Principal did not name in order to be helpful. Each is a document about a child's conduct and record, issued by the school in its own name.
branch_id comes from $session.

reversal.statement: A certificate decision is recorded again rather than withdrawn. A certificate already issued has reached the family.

request.text: leaving certificate aur transcript jari karo, character certificate nahi
request.gloss: issue the leaving certificate and the transcript, not the character certificate

inputs.certificate_types: the school leaving certificate and the transcript, as named

steps.note: The complete list is the Principal's (PR-1).

resolvedPlans.outcome: Recorded, and those two are raised as requests. Report the character certificate as withheld (PR-3), and that the leaving certificate is issued — which is what lets the child enrol elsewhere.

request.text: expulsion hai, koi certificate nahi dena
request.gloss: it is an expulsion, no certificates at all

steps.note: Recorded as the Principal decided (PR-1).

resolvedPlans.outcome: Report before recording it what withholding the school leaving certificate means (PR-2): it is effectively required for the child to enrol anywhere else, so the practical effect is a child who may not be able to attend another school. It is the Principal's decision to take — and it should be taken knowing that, rather than as part of a general refusal.

request.text: jo hamesha jari hote hain wahi kar do
request.gloss: issue the usual ones

steps.note: No plan is emitted. There is no default, and it is the Principal's decision (PR-1, PR-4).

resolvedPlans.outcome: Nothing is recorded and the case cannot close. Report that the Principal names each certificate explicitly — the rule exists precisely so that issuing or withholding one is a decision somebody took rather than a default that followed from the case type.
